# Get-ZbxTemplate

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the templates that hosts are linked to.

## DESCRIPTION

A template is a reusable set of items, triggers, graphs, discovery rules and dashboards; linking it to a host gives the host all of them. The Get-ZbxTemplate cmdlet reads them with template.get: all of them up to -Limit, by name with -Name (* and ? are wildcards), by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole template.get selection in -Filter. -Group, -ParentTemplate, -Host and the other object filters narrow the result to the templates of the objects given, each a name, an id or a piped object. It writes ZabbixTemplate objects, with their related objects when a -Select switch asks for them, or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get a template by name

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplate -Name 'Web App' | Select-Object TemplateId, TechnicalName, VisibleName
```

-Name matches the template's technical name exactly; TechnicalName and VisibleName carry the API's host and name.

### Example 2: Get the templates linked to a host

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplate -Host 'web-01' | Select-Object TemplateId, TechnicalName
```

-Host takes a host name, id or object.

### Example 3: List the templates of a template group with their items

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplate -Group 'Templates/Web' -SelectItems |
    ForEach-Object { '{0}: {1}' -f $_.TechnicalName, ($_.Items.Key -join ', ') }
```

-Group takes template group names, ids or objects; -SelectItems adds each template's items.

### Example 4: Inspect a built-in template's macros

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplate -Name 'Linux by Zabbix agent' -SelectMacros |
    ForEach-Object Macros | Select-Object -First 5 Macro, Value
```

The -Select* switches add related objects; here the macros that tune 'Linux by Zabbix agent'.
